why_ai: Multi-craft technicians and building engineers keep plant running on site, with licensed trades and accreditation sign-offs adding accountability.
why_clarity: SLA schedules, PM task libraries and code-set inspection frequencies define the work, though diagnosing plant faults rests on the engineer's feel.
why_digital: Physical buildings serviced in person, bought through local and national RFPs.

why_ai: Running a corporate portfolio is hands-on building work sold through long client relationships and rebid every few years.
why_clarity: KPIs and SLA schedules are explicit, but margin depends on judgement calls about pricing and delivery that resolve slowly.
why_digital: Buildings run on site; reporting and procurement are digital, delivery is physical.

why_ai: Pricing an unmeasured portfolio for five years is a novel, high-stakes judgement with feedback only after transition.
why_clarity: Bid structure is standard, but the estimate is checked against reality months later and each portfolio differs.
why_digital: Asset lists and site walks feed spreadsheet models and a written bid.

why_ai: Make-or-buy calls weigh workforce, density and SLA risk in each metro, informed by data but owned by operations leaders.
why_clarity: Cost per job and SLA attainment are measurable, but the decision recurs only quarterly and per metro.
why_digital: Work-order, payroll and invoice data analysed on screen to decide physical delivery.

why_ai: Installation maintenance and utilities operation are physical work on bases, rated by government evaluators.
why_clarity: Performance work statements and surveillance plans define standards and acceptable quality levels.
why_digital: Physical installations run by on-site workforces, bought through federal solicitations.

why_ai: Hospital plant work is hands-on and tied to patient safety and accreditation, with accountable directors signing off.
why_clarity: NFPA frequencies and accreditation elements of performance define what must be done and documented.
why_digital: Physical hospital plant operated and tested on site by local teams.

why_ai: Governing the inspection calendar is screen work with compliance accountability; the inspections themselves are done by subcontractors.
why_clarity: Code-set frequencies and deficiency classes make due, done and passed an exact, checkable status.
why_digital: Vendor reports and calendars handled on screen for physical systems in local jurisdictions.

why_ai: Technicians repair plant with their hands in plant rooms and on roofs, often under trade licences.
why_clarity: A repair works or it does not, but diagnosis across unfamiliar buildings relies on experience.
why_digital: Physical equipment repaired in person by locally employed technicians.

why_ai: Contract governance blends relationship and negotiation with reconciliation work that software can increasingly do.
why_clarity: KPIs and invoices recur monthly against written definitions, but disputes turn on interpretation.
why_digital: Provider data, invoices and contracts reviewed on screen, with occasional site walks.

why_ai: Classifying and routing requests is routine screen work that language models already perform.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical requests a day, each with a contract-defined priority checked when the job closes.
why_digital: Calls, emails and portal requests in, dispatched work orders out, run from national desks.

why_ai: Matching invoices to work orders and rate cards is rule-bound document processing that AI absorbs directly.
why_clarity: Every invoice is checked against explicit rates, ceilings and contract terms with a pass or fail result.
why_digital: Invoices and work orders processed entirely on screen.

why_ai: A registered design professional certifies each filing, and the compliance plan carries engineering judgement on real buildings.
why_clarity: Filed emissions either meet the limit or not under published calculation rules, though plan accuracy shows only years later.
why_digital: Utility and audit data analysed on screen and filed online, sold to local owners in each jurisdiction.

why_ai: Assessors walk every building and system on site, aided by drawings and prior data, and their capital forecasts drive institutional budgets.
why_clarity: Condition ratings and remaining-life tables follow standard formats, checked only at the next assessment.
why_digital: On-site building walks produce digital condition databases for institutional owners nationwide.

why_ai: Member-contributed campus data and an established benchmark brand cannot be generated by AI.
why_clarity: Annual benchmarks follow a fixed collection and reporting method for each member campus.
why_digital: Contributed data analysed on screen and presented to campus leadership, largely remotely.

why_ai: Surveyors inspect hospital buildings in person, and accreditation carries CMS deemed status.
why_clarity: Standards and elements of performance are codified, but whether compliance prevents harm is slow to show.
why_digital: On-site surveys produce digital findings for hospitals bought through a handful of accreditors.

why_ai: Advising on outsourcing decisions and negotiations rests on judgement and trusted advisers across the table.
why_clarity: Benchmarks and bid evaluations are defined deliverables, but deals are few and each portfolio differs.
why_digital: Bid data and contracts analysed on screen, with some site visits, sold to occupiers nationally.

why_ai: In-product benchmarks and contractor scores are routine data work AI generates readily.
why_clarity: Work-order and invoice metrics are defined and computed continuously.
why_digital: Platform data in, analytics shipped inside software.

why_ai: Underwriting engineers carry pricing accountability, but the analysis itself is desk work on claims and inspection data.
why_clarity: Loss experience gives measurable outcomes, slowly, across large books of similar objects.
why_digital: Inspection and claims records analysed on screen; inspections themselves happen on site.

why_ai: Rule-based and model-based fault detection on trend data is exactly the work software and AI keep absorbing.
why_clarity: Faults are defined by rules and confirmed or not when the site team investigates.
why_digital: Building trend data in, prioritised fault reports out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Certification depends on on-site assessment and a brand operators and their customers trust.
why_clarity: Tier criteria are codified, but research on outages draws on varied, partly self-reported incidents.
why_digital: Site assessments and member data feed digital certifications and reports sold worldwide.

why_ai: Price-to-win and capture judgement is adversarial and high-stakes, though cost modelling is increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Bid structures are standard, and each award gives a win or loss against a known price.
why_digital: Solicitations and cost data in, proposals out, all on screen.

why_ai: Vendor assessments built on briefings and surveys are increasingly within reach of AI-native research.
why_clarity: Ratings and forecasts are matters of analyst judgement with little objective check.
why_digital: Briefings and surveys in, reports and calls out, sold online.

why_ai: Government engineers and contracting officers hold statutory authority over facilities and contracts.
why_clarity: Condition and maintenance priorities follow guidance, but effectiveness is hard to measure on unreliable data.
why_digital: Physical installations assessed and managed partly on screen; no market purchase involved.

why_ai: Wage determinations carry statutory authority, though compiling them from survey data is mechanical.
why_clarity: Each determination is an exact rate table produced by a codified method at volume.
why_digital: Survey data in, published determinations out; a government function with no buyer market.

why_ai: Evaluators inspect contractor work in person and their findings carry contractual authority.
why_clarity: Surveillance plans define standards and sampling methods for repeated inspections.
why_digital: Physical inspection on installations, recorded digitally for the contracting officer.

why_ai: Member-contributed data and association standing cannot be generated by AI.
why_clarity: Annual surveys follow a fixed collection and publication process.
why_digital: Member data compiled on screen and published as reports.

why_ai: Acquisition judgement is novel and consequential, but the modelling behind it is increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Deal models are standard, but each target differs and outcomes appear years later.
why_digital: Diligence files in, models and integration plans out, on screen.
